description: This Java source file defines the class ActionsPresets, which is a collection of various notification action presets used to configure notifications with different actions and behaviors, particularly for Android Wearables. It includes nested classes representing different preset configurations for notification actions, such as no actions, single action, reply actions, and different behaviors on phone and wearable devices.

classes.name: ActionsPresets
classes.description: A utility class providing preset configurations of notification actions for Android notifications, especially tailored for Wear OS devices.

classes.name: NoActionsPreset
classes.description: A preset that applies no actions to a notification.

classes.name: SingleActionPreset
classes.description: A preset that adds a single action button to a notification.

classes.name: LongTitleActionPreset
classes.description: A preset that adds an action with a long title to a notification.

classes.name: ReplyActionPreset
classes.description: A preset that adds a reply action with remote input to a notification.

classes.name: ReplyWithChoicesActionPreset
classes.description: A preset that adds a reply action with multiple choices.

classes.name: DifferentActionsOnPhoneAndWearable
classes.description: A preset that configures different actions for phone and wearable devices.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Overrides in subclasses to configure specific actions on the notification builder and wearable options.
